title: Login failure after deployment
description: Users cannot log in after the latest application deployment. The login page loads but submitting credentials returns a 500 error.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Navigate to login page. 2. Enter valid credentials. 3. Click Login.

title: Dropdown label overlaps button on mobile
description: On screens narrower than 375px, the category dropdown label overlaps the submit button in the new filter panel.
users_affected: 3 (QA team only, reproduced on iPhone SE)
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open app on iPhone SE or narrow viewport. 2. Navigate to Products. 3. Open filter panel.
workaround: Rotate to landscape mode or use desktop browser.

title: App crashes on startup
description: The mobile app crashes immediately on launch for users who upgraded to v3.2.1.

title: Payment fails intermittently
description: Some users report payment failures at checkout, but the same card works on retry. Affects roughly 5% of transactions.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Add item to cart. 2. Proceed to checkout. 3. Enter card details. 4. Submit payment.

title: Export button does nothing
description: Clicking the Export CSV button on the reports page does not trigger a download. No error is shown.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Navigate to Reports. 2. Click Export CSV.

title: Database corruption after batch import
description: Running the nightly batch import job corrupts user records when the input file contains Unicode characters above U+FFFF.
users_affected: All users whose records were in the import batch (~1200)
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Prepare CSV with emoji in name field. 2. Run batch import script. 3. Query affected records.
workaround: None — corrupted records require manual restore from backup.
